pages.title: Ember & Bean — Premium Coffee Roastery
pages.html:
Ember ☕ Bean
Shop Subscribe Testimonials

Ember & Bean

Expertly roasted, sustainably sourced coffee for your daily ritual.

Discover single-origin beans and custom blends roasted fresh in Portland. From our shop to your cup, every bean tells a story.

Shop Now Subscribe Today

Featured Beans

Handpicked selections from around the world, roasted to perfection.

Ethiopian Yirgacheffe

Bright, fruity notes with a hint of jasmine. Perfect for pour-over and espresso.

$16.99 / 12 oz

Colombian Supremo

Rich chocolate and caramel notes. A smooth, balanced daily drinker.

$15.99 / 12 oz

Ember Blend

Our signature dark roast. Bold, smoky, with a velvety finish. Our customer favorite.

$14.99 / 12 oz

Kenyan AA

Wine and berry notes with a bright acidity. Complex and expressive.

$17.99 / 12 oz

Guatemala Huehuetenango

Spicy, earthy, with hints of nuts and cocoa. A versatile choice for any brew method.

$15.99 / 12 oz

Seasonal Summer Blend

Limited edition. Light roast with bright citrus and stone fruit. Available June–August.

$16.49 / 12 oz

Coffee Subscription Plans

Never run out of freshly roasted beans. Choose your frequency and get coffee delivered straight to your door.

Starter

One 12 oz bag every month

$15.99 / month

  • One rotating single-origin bean
  • Free shipping on subscription orders
  • Discount code for shop purchases
  • Cancel anytime
Most Popular

Connoisseur

Two 12 oz bags every two weeks

$31.99 / month

  • Two different beans per shipment
  • Priority roasting and shipping
  • 10% discount on all shop purchases
  • Quarterly brewing guide and tasting notes
  • Cancel anytime

Enthusiast

One bag every week

$61.99 / month

  • Four beans per month (all different)
  • First access to limited editions
  • 15% discount on all purchases
  • Monthly tasting events and brewing classes
  • Direct access to our head roaster
  • Cancel anytime

How It Works

  1. Choose Your Plan: Select a subscription tier that fits your coffee needs and budget.
  2. Customize Your Beans: Tell us your roast preferences—light, medium, or dark. We'll rotate new single-origins and blends based on what's available.
  3. Fresh Delivery: Your coffee arrives within 48 hours of roasting, packaged in our recyclable kraft bags.
  4. Manage Your Subscription: Skip a month, change your frequency, or adjust your bean selection anytime from your account dashboard.

What Our Customers Say

★★★★★
"Ember & Bean completely transformed my morning coffee routine. The beans are so fresh and the flavor is incomparable to anything I've had before. I'm on the Connoisseur plan and love trying new origins every two weeks."

— Sarah Chen, Seattle, WA

★★★★★
"As someone who takes my coffee seriously, I've tried dozens of roasters. Ember & Bean's attention to detail and commitment to sourcing is evident in every cup. Their Ethiopian Yirgacheffe is my go-to."

— Marcus Johnson, Portland, OR

★★★★★
"I switched to the Enthusiast subscription last year and haven't looked back. The monthly tasting events are fantastic, and the brewing guides have genuinely improved my technique. Worth every penny."

— Jennifer Martinez, Portland, OR

Join hundreds of coffee lovers who have discovered the Ember & Bean difference. Start your journey today.
